description: The summary role's cloud option asked for an arbitrary HTTPS endpoint (Settings > Privacy 'Cloud summary service address') backed by the services/summary-api relay. Replace it with five named provider options in the Summary dropdown, each a normal cloud service that requires only its own API key in Settings > Services, like Soniox and Speechmatics. Drops Settings.cloudSummaryEndpoint and the summaryEndpoint selection requirement; adds per-provider secrets, consent keys and an optional model override.
title: Cloud summaries pick an LLM provider (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter) instead of a custom endpoint
